title: Arcs over a baseline

techniques.name: Counted arcs

dpx.label: Dot size
dpx.note: Each dot is a square of whole device pixels; each arc is a dotted line of these squares. The deck prints at 4.

cell.label: Screen pitch
cell.note: Spacing of the dots along each arc, as a multiple of the deck’s own.

den.label: Density
den.note: How many of each arc’s dots print, as a multiple of the deck’s own. Past 1.25 the arcs close into solid lines.

count.label: Arcs
count.note: How many arcs rise over the baseline, as a multiple of the deck’s 28; each arc spans one exchange.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-deals where every dot falls. 0 is the deck’s own print.

techniques.implementation: A ribbon twisted about its axis is filled with dots whose density follows the face turned toward you, one ink per side; the same dots print the bars and arcs. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
